title: How can the length of a wire be written in three ways?
description: A wire ends four small parts after a tenth mark. Its length is written with units, tenths and hundredths, then with units and hundredths, and then as a count of hundredths. Keeko doubts the count and adds the tenth to the hundredths as if they were the same size.
teaching_notes: One idea: a tenth is ten hundredths and a unit is one hundred hundredths, so one length can be written in three ways. Watch for students who add the digit of the tenths to the digit of the hundredths.

source: A wire ends 4 small parts after the 1 1/10 mark. Write its length in three ways.
video_script.why: The child has named the hundredth and now writes one length as units, tenths and hundredths, as units and hundredths, and as hundredths.
video_script.substitution: A tenth is ten hundredths and a unit is one hundred hundredths, so change the bigger parts into hundredths.
video_script.anchor: A wire along a unit scale that ends four small parts after the 1 1/10 mark, with each tenth cut into ten parts
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko adds 1 tenth and 4 hundredths as 1 + 4 = 5 hundredths, but 1 tenth is 10 hundredths, so the wire is 1 and 14 hundredths.
video_script.payoff_line: The wire is one unit, one tenth and four hundredths long

final_answer.spoken: one unit, one tenth and four hundredths, which is also one and fourteen hundredths, and one hundred fourteen hundredths of a unit

maths_rules: 1 tenth = 10 hundredths, and 10 + 4 = 14 hundredths, so the wire is 1 unit and 14 hundredths, 1 14/100.
Slip: 1 tenth + 4 hundredths is not 5 hundredths, because 1 tenth is 10 hundredths.
video_script.design: One idea: a tenth is ten hundredths and a unit is one hundred hundredths. Assumes the child has named the hundredth. Wrong idea: add the tenths digit and the hundredths digit as if they were the same size. The wire and its scale stay all video.
